text: _Ancare Number,_ such are mutually equal to the ten of one another’s aliquipur parts. Thus the numbers 284 and 230 are amicable numbers : for the alt- parparts 1, 2, 4, 5, 19, 11, 20, 23, 44, 55, 110, of 220, are targeted equal to each other than 284 ‡ and the aliquipur parts 1, 2, 4, 71, 142, of 284, are together equal to 230.

parsed.faithful: Amicable Numbers, such as are mutually equal to the sum of one another's aliquot parts. Thus the numbers 284 and 220 are amicable numbers : for the aliquot parts 1, 2, 4, 5, 10, 11, 20, 22, 44, 55, 110, of 220, are together equal to the other number 284 ; and the aliquot parts 1, 2, 4, 71, 142, of 284, are together equal to 220.
